description: Assign the active document's RGB and CMYK profiles without converting colour values, set its colour policies, and set its rendering intents for solid colours, images and after blending (Edit > Assign Profiles)

cmykProfile.description: CMYK profile name from get_color_settings (document.cmykProfiles, with includeLists), or "working" for the current CMYK working space

rgbProfile.description: RGB profile name from get_color_settings (document.rgbProfiles, with includeLists), or "working" for the current RGB working space

solidColorIntent.description: Solid Color Intent (vector art and native objects)

name: assign_document_profiles
title: Assign Document Profiles
